profile_text: Specializing in the storage and handling of hazardous materials, this German-based firm has experienced rapid growth, with a 226.7% increase in employees since its baseline. Its expertise in managing high-risk substances has driven expansion, catering to industries that require secure and compliant storage solutions. As a result, the company has established itself as a key player in the transportation and storage sector, with 49 employees as of 2024.
